views.markdown: Everything in the free build, with the parts it keeps locked opened up.

Edit all ten keys on both rows, including the characters they show on Shift.

Choose which row appears in each situation: normally, on Shift, and on 123.

Adjust the keyboard height.

Keep five rows when switching with 123 or ABC.
Not released yet. This repo carries the free build only.

views.title: Compatibility
views.text: iOS 15 and later. Separate Rootless and RootHide packages. Confirmed by users on iOS 15.4, 16.4, 16.5, 16.6, 16.7 and 17.0.

views.markdown:
- Fixed the package page showing an error in Sileo
- Refreshed the package description to match what the build actually does

- Shift and 123 now show the punctuation row you actually use (fixes the doubled number row)
- Rename the ABC and 123 keys, up to five characters each
- Added a reset-to-defaults button
- Always show five rows is now on by default
- Better diagnostic logging, plus a support email
- Various interface and stability fixes
- First public beta, posted on r/jailbreak
